_readme: Sites for scripts/share-image.cjs (link preview picture: laptop + phone). One entry per site.
dir: the folder that is served (the script runs its own local server of the repo root). path: the page under the repo root.
live: the site's live address; the picture's URL is live + imageDir + file name.
imageDir: where the JPG goes, relative to the site's folder (dir). html: pages to point at it (folder/*.html patterns).
phone.top: the first thing the phone shows under the site header (several selectors: the highest one wins).
phone.bottom: the last thing that must show in full (it fails the run if it does not fit).

phone.align: center (default) splits the spare room above and below without showing the section above; top puts phone.top just under the header; bottom puts phone.bottom just above the screen's lower edge.
phone.hideBelow: true (default) hides everything below phone.bottom, so the next row of cards never peeks in cut off.
The raw phone shot is saved to qa/share/<id>/phone.png for checking.
client: true means a paying client's live site: the picture goes to qa/share/ and no page is changed. Ben sees it first.
preview: a prospect preview built by scripts/build-preview.mjs. The picture is also saved to prospects/share/<slug>/ so every rebuild uses it.

phone._note: Its cards are tall, so headline + the big photo card is what fits.
